name: Pavestone 24 in. x 24 in. x 1.96 in. Pewter Square Concrete Step Stone(28-Pieces/112 sq. ft./Pallet), Silver
description: The 24 in. square patio stone is an easy addition to a patio or pathway. It is also great for step stones in a garden or for a walkway. Outdoor patios combine the best of interior comforts with Mother Nature's loveliness. Families can relax, play, dine, and entertain while experiencing what has always made patios popular: being outside. Your property can be transformed into an outdoor living room with a little imagination. Color: Pewter.
